simple.meaning: פָּלַס (pâlaç) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to roll flat , i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve , i.e. weigh (mentally).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פָּלַס (H6424) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 58:3, with occurrences in Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah.

definitions.short: properly, to roll flat , i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve , i.e. weigh (mentally)
definitions.full: H6424. palas [ מָּלַס ] verb Pi`el denominative weigh, make level (Phoenician פלס Pi`el make level (?) in proper names); — Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפַלֵּס Psa 78:20 ; 2 masculine plural תְּפַלֵּס֑וּן 58:3 (see below), etc.; Imperative masculine singular מַּלֵּס Prov 4:26 ; Participle מְפַלֵּס 5:11 ; — 1 weign out תּפי יְדֵיכֶם חֲמַס Psa 58:3 (figurative; but read perhaps תְּפַלֵּסְנָה יְדֵיכֶם תָמָס violence do your hands weigh out , so ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Bae Kau We). 2 make level , smooth (compare Gerber 32 ), with accusative of path (figurative), מַעְגָּל Prov 4:26 ; 5:21 ; Isa 26:7 , נָתִּיב Psa 78:50 , אֹרַח Prov 5:6 .

occurrences.englishText: The wicked go astray from the womb.
He made a path for his anger.
Make the path of your feet level.
She gives no thought to the way of life.
For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes.
The way of the just is uprightness.
